title: SnapshotManifest
description: Immutable, write-once, hash-verifiable manifest of everything the production model knew at one point in time (one stage, one date). See docs/SNAPSHOT_ARCHITECTURE.md. A manifest never embeds bulky payloads itself -- it references (REFERENCED_IMMUTABLE) or points to a frozen copy (FROZEN_COPY) of each component via lib/edgelab/schema_v1/snapshot_component.schema.json.

snapshotId.description: sha1('snapshot', snapshotStage, snapshotDate) -- see lib/edgelab/ids.py:build_snapshot_id. Deterministic and write-once per (stage, date): a second capture attempt for the same key must verify-and-no-op or fail loudly, never silently produce a second manifest.

snapshotStage.description: PRE_GAME_DECISION: everything known before first pitch, when the production decision was made. POST_GAME_SETTLEMENT: outcomes/settlement/CLV, captured only after the fact, never merged back into a PRE_GAME_DECISION manifest. CLOSING_LINE: the finalized closing quote per market, derived from checkpoint=CLOSING observations once no earlier quote can still arrive.

snapshotDate.description: The slate date (YYYY-MM-DD) this snapshot describes -- not the wall-clock date it was captured on (POST_GAME_SETTLEMENT/CLOSING_LINE are captured the following day).

capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp this manifest was written.

productionRunId.description: The EdgeLab runId (see lib/edgelab/ids.py:new_run_id) of the ingestion run that produced this manifest, when one exists.

workflowRunId.description: GitHub Actions run_id (github.run_id) of the workflow invocation that created this snapshot, when running in Actions; null for local/manual runs.

productionCommitSha.description: Best-known git commit SHA of the code that PRODUCED the upstream artifacts this snapshot references (e.g. data/pipeline/<date>/recommendations.json's own meta, when it carries one). Distinct from snapshotWriterCommitSha -- see docs/SNAPSHOT_ARCHITECTURE.md's 'ingestion-vs-production commit skew' note. Null when no upstream artifact recorded its own producing commit.

snapshotWriterCommitSha.description: git commit SHA of THIS repo checkout at the moment this manifest was written (same convention as lib/edgelab/model_evaluation.py's _git_commit_sha()). This is the snapshot-creation-time commit, not necessarily productionCommitSha.

modelVersion.description: No single global model/engine version exists in this repository today (confirmed: only f5PricingVersion is populated, for F5_ML_Away/Home rows). Always null at this schema version -- see pricingVersionsByFamily for the one real, populated version.

pricingVersionsByFamily.description: Map of market-family-name -> pricing/model version string, populated only for families that actually carry one today (e.g. {'F5_ML': 'f5_three_way_v1'}). Families with no versioning concept are simply absent, never given a fabricated value.

rulesConfigVersion.description: config/rules.json's own '_version' field at capture time, copied verbatim. NOT claimed to be the complete production rule set -- see the EFFECTIVE_CONFIG component and docs/SNAPSHOT_ARCHITECTURE.md's 'effective configuration' section for why rules.json alone is insufficient.

replayFidelityPotential.description: The BEST replay fidelity level this snapshot could support if consumed today, mechanically derived from component availability -- never a narrative judgment. See docs/SNAPSHOT_ARCHITECTURE.md.

completenessStatus.description: Mechanically derived from component availabilityStatus values (see lib/edgelab/snapshot.py:derive_completeness_status), never assigned by narrative judgment.

components.description: Every SnapshotComponent this stage assesses, including ones with availabilityStatus MISSING/NOT_APPLICABLE_FOR_STAGE -- a component that was never captured still gets an explicit entry, never a silent omission.

missingComponents.description: componentType values (from components) whose availabilityStatus is MISSING -- denormalized for fast lookup without scanning the full components array.

limitationReasons.description: Deduplicated union of every non-null component limitationReason, plus any stage-level limitation (e.g. POSTGAME_DATA_EXCLUDED_FROM_PREGAME_SNAPSHOT).

linkedSnapshotIds.description: snapshotId values of OTHER stage manifests for the same snapshotDate that this manifest links to (e.g. a POST_GAME_SETTLEMENT manifest links back to its PRE_GAME_DECISION snapshotId). The earlier-stage manifest is never mutated to add a forward link -- only later manifests carry a linkedSnapshotIds pointer backward.

manifestHash.description: SHA-256 of this manifest's own canonical, content-only serialization (sorted keys; capturedAt/workflowRunId/productionRunId/snapshotWriterCommitSha/provenance/manifestHash itself excluded -- those are 'when/how captured' facts, not 'what was captured'). Proves the captured DATA has not changed since creation -- see lib/edgelab/snapshot.py:compute_manifest_hash.
